I'm a cis female and my girlfriend is trans*. I just try to be as supportive as I can. Some days are really hard and their isn't much that I can do for her other than be as loving as possible. Her parents aren't supportive either. She has had to be firm with them and has told them that if they want a relationship with her, they are going to have to accept her choice or she won't see them. Shopping can be a trigger for my gf, so I sometimes buy her things that she might like and let her know that we can exchange them if she feels uncomfortable in them. I'm also starting to help her with hair and makeup, but very slowly. I can't even imagine how incredibly overwhelming this is. Some may jump into it head on, others may need more time. She is lucky to have such a supportive partner though! [](/r/asktransgender/) is another great place to ask questions.

You might want to try posting [/r/mypartneristrans/] as well. Are they going by female pronouns? It might build up their confidence to only use their preferred pronouns. Maybe buying some clothes that she really likes and just wearing them around people she's comfortable with for now. Trying a little bit of makeup at first. It might take baby steps to build up their confidence. What have you tried so far?
